mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employment_rate_achievements (management_no, target_user_id, evaluation_year, management_item_code, achievement_date, achievement_name, attachment_ids, certification_status, deleted_yn, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{managementNo}, #{targetUserId}, #{evaluationYear}, #{managementItemCode}, #{achievementDate}, #{achievementName}, CAST(#{attachmentIds} AS jsonb), 'DRAFT', 'N', #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE employment_rate_achievements SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{achievementDate}, achievement_name = #{achievementName}, attachment_ids = CAST(#{attachmentIds} AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) VALUES ('employment_rate_achievements', #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, 'achievement_name', #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, '취업률 실적 변경', #{requestId})

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO excel_upload_files (upload_id, business_type, file_token, original_file_name, validation_status, uploader_user_id) VALUES (#{uploadId}, 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE', CONCAT('employment-rate-', #{uploadId}), #{fileName}, #{status}, #{userId}); INSERT INTO excel_upload_histories (upload_id, total_count, success_count, error_count, saved_count, processor_user_id) VALUES (#{uploadId}, #{total}, #{success}, #{errors}, CASE WHEN #{errors} = 0 THEN #{total} ELSE 0 END, #{userId})

INSERT INTO employment_rate_upload_errors (upload_id, row_number, column_name, input_value, error_code, error_reason) VALUES (#{uploadId}, #{error.rowNumber}, #{error.columnName}, #{error.inputValue}, #{error.errorCode}, #{error.errorReason})
